title: Mongo-sharded: backup take (mongodump through mongos)
description: Runs `nexus backup take mongo-sharded`: mongodump --archive --gzip of the sharded DB nexus_n_smoke, connecting THROUGH a mongos router (collects the routed data of the sharded collection). Archive written node-local on the mongos.

observe.what: GREEN; destination = /var/backups/nexus-mongo-sharded/<id>.archive.gz on mongo-mongos-1; non-zero size

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.BackupTakeAsync dumps the sharded database through mongos as nexus-sharded-admin — the standard sharded-cluster backup path — writing a single gzip archive node-local on the router.
